asurre.selection_rule: Hold out the source with the smallest total respondent count; break ties by the most recent survey year.
asurre.provenance: Counts are copied from the version-controlled ASURRE source configs under data/raw/asurre/configs. The decision was made before fitting or inspecting model outcomes.

gss.selection_rule: Use categorical core questions with 2-4 substantive choices and at least 500 usable responses, spanning wellbeing, interpersonal trust, and institutional confidence; exclude demographics and political or religious identity.
gss.ingestion_requirement: Copy exact wording, value codes, missing-value codes, release identifier, and checksum from the official NORC export into the GSS loader manifest before building the bank.
